function canAccessGrammarItem(grammarId) {
let userTier = localStorage.getItem('sb_user_tier') || 'free';
const level = getGrammarItemLevel(grammarId);
if (userTier === 'free') {
return level === 'A1';
}
if (userTier === 'starter') {
return level === 'A1' || level === 'A2';
}
return true; // PRO can access all
}

function onGrammarItemClick(grammarId, grammarTitle) {
if (!canAccessGrammarItem(grammarId)) {
// paywall removed
return;
}
// Access granted, open normally
const idx = a1GrammarDatabase.findIndex(g => g.id === grammarId);
if (idx !== -1) {
activeGrammarIndex = idx;
renderActiveTabModule();
}
}

return examLevel || 'A1';
}

const level = getExamLevel(examLevel);
if (userTier === 'free') {
return level === 'A1';
}
if (userTier === 'starter') {
return level === 'A1' || level === 'A2';
}
return true; // PRO can access all
}

// Native Browser Audio Speech Synthesis Runner.
// stripParens is used for flashcards only ("A (Aa)" should read as "A").
// Full sentences (exam dialogues, sample answers) are spoken verbatim.
// ===== Speech on iOS =====
// iPhone and iPad impose four rules that desktop browsers do not:
// 1. the very first speak() must happen inside a real user gesture,
// 2. the queue silently pauses and has to be resume()d,
// 3. cancel() immediately followed by speak() swallows the utterance,
// 4. the ringer switch mutes speech entirely, with no error raised.
// This layer handles 1-3 and warns the user about 4.
const isAppleMobile = (function () {
const ua = (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.userAgent) || '';
return /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)
|| (ua.includes('Macintosh') && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
})();

let speechPrimed = false;
let speechEverStarted = false;
let speechFinished = false;
let speechHintShown = false;

// Deliberately a no-op. A silent priming utterance leaves the synth busy,
// which forced the next real call down a deferred path that iOS blocks.
// Every speak() in this app already runs inside a click handler.
function primeSpeech() { speechPrimed = true; }

function showSilentSwitchHint() {
if (speechHintShown || speechEverStarted || !isAppleMobile) return;
speechHintShown = true;
const el = document.createElement('div');
let vcount = 0, hasDe = false;
try {
const vs = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
vcount = vs.length;
hasDe = vs.some(v => v.lang && v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith('de'));
} catch (e) {}
el.innerHTML = '\ud83d\udd07 <b>No sound?</b> Check the ringer switch is ON and turn the volume up '
+ 'while the page is speaking.<br><br>German voice: Settings \u2192 Accessibility \u2192 Spoken Content '
+ '\u2192 Voices \u2192 Deutsch.<br><br><span style="opacity:.7">Voices found: ' + vcount
+ ' \u00b7 German available: ' + (hasDe ? 'yes' : 'no') + '</span>';
el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:84px;z-index:9997;background:#1e293b;'
+ 'color:#e2e8f0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;'
+ 'box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);border:1px solid #334155';
el.onclick = () => el.remove();
document.body.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 9000);
}

// ---- Pre-rendered audio ----
// If tools/generate-audio.py has been run, real neural-voice MP3s exist for
// most phrases; they sound far closer to a real exam than the browser voice.
// Anything without a file falls back to speech synthesis, so the app works
// whether or not the audio has been generated.
let sbAudioManifest = null;
let sbCurrentAudio = null;

fetch('./audio-manifest.json')
.then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
.then(m => { sbAudioManifest = m || {}; })
.catch(() => { sbAudioManifest = {}; });

// Must match phrase_id() in tools/generate-audio.py: the first 16 hex
// characters of the SHA-1 of the trimmed text.
async function sbPhraseId(text) {
if (!window.crypto || !crypto.subtle) return null;
const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-1', new TextEncoder().encode(String(text).trim()));
return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').slice(0, 16);
}

async function sbPlayRecorded(text) {
if (!sbAudioManifest || !Object.keys(sbAudioManifest).length) return false;
const id = await sbPhraseId(text);
if (!id || !sbAudioManifest[id]) return false;
try {
if (sbCurrentAudio) { sbCurrentAudio.pause(); sbCurrentAudio = null; }
// Piper without ffmpeg writes WAV; everything else writes MP3.
const ext = (sbAudioManifest[id] === 'wav') ? '.wav' : '.mp3';
const a = new Audio('./audio/' + id + ext);
a.playbackRate = Math.max(0.6, Math.min(1.2, (typeof speechRate === 'number' ? speechRate : 0.9) + 0.1));
sbCurrentAudio = a;
await a.play();
speechEverStarted = true;
return true;
} catch (e) {
return false; // autoplay blocked or file missing: fall back
}
}

function speakGerman(text, stripParens) {
if (typeof soundOn !== 'undefined' && !soundOn) return;
const forAudio = stripParens ? String(text).split('(')[0].trim() : String(text);
// Recorded voice first; synthesise only when there is no file for it.
sbPlayRecorded(forAudio).then(played => { if (!played) sbSynthGerman(text, stripParens); });
}

function sbSynthGerman(text, stripParens) {
if (!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
if (typeof soundOn !== 'undefined' && !soundOn) return;
const synth = window.speechSynthesis;
const clean = stripParens ? String(text).split('(')[0].trim() : String(text);
if (!clean) return;

// iOS parks the queue; resume() is required before anything will play
try { synth.resume(); } catch (e) {}

const fire = () => {
const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(clean);
u.lang = 'de-DE';
u.rate = (typeof speechRate === 'number' ? speechRate : 0.85);
u.volume = 1;
const voices = synth.getVoices();
const de = voices.find(v => v.lang === 'de-DE') || voices.find(v => v.lang && v.lang.startsWith('de'));
if (de) u.voice = de;
u.onstart = () => { speechEverStarted = true; speechFinished = false; };
u.onend = () => { speechEverStarted = true; speechFinished = true; };
u.onerror = (e) => {
if (e && e.error === 'interrupted' || e && e.error === 'canceled') return;
showSilentSwitchHint();
};
synth.speak(u);
// Only warn when the engine truly never engaged. iOS can take well over
// a second to start the first utterance, and synth.speaking stays true
// while it is working, so both are checked before showing anything.
setTimeout(() => {
const busy = synth.speaking || synth.pending;
if (!speechEverStarted && !busy) showSilentSwitchHint();
}, 2600);
};

if (isAppleMobile) {
// Must stay inside the user gesture - no timers allowed here
try { if (synth.speaking || synth.pending) synth.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
fire();
} else if (synth.speaking || synth.pending) {
// Desktop WebKit loses an utterance if cancel() and speak() share a tick
synth.cancel();
setTimeout(fire, 40);
} else {
fire();
}
}

// Flashcard helper - keeps the parenthetical stripping behaviour
function triggerSpeechSynthesis(text) { speakGerman(text, true); }

// Safely embed a JS string as an argument inside a single-quoted HTML
// onclick="'...'" attribute. JSON.stringify alone does NOT escape
// apostrophes, so any exam text containing one (e.g. "ich bin's") would
// otherwise prematurely terminate the attribute and corrupt the markup.
function safeOnclickArg(str) {
return JSON.stringify(str).replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

// Algorithmic Large-Scale Number Generator Engine Method (0 to 100 Million converter rule matrix)
function generateGermanNumberStringFormula(num) {
if (num === 0) return "null";
const units = ["", "eins", "zwei", "drei", "vier", "fünf", "sechs", "sieben", "acht", "neun"];
const teens = ["zehn", "elf", "zwölf", "dreizehn", "vierzehn", "fünfzehn", "sechzehn", "siebzehn", "achtzehn", "neunzehn"];
const tens = ["", "zehn", "zwanzig", "dreißig", "vierzig", "fünfzig", "sechzig", "siebzig", "achtzig", "neunzig"];

function convertSubHundreds(val) {
if (val < 10) return units[val];
if (val < 20) return teens[val - 10];
const u = val % 10;
const t = Math.floor(val / 10);
if (u === 0) return tens[t];
return (u === 1 ? "ein" : units[u]) + "und" + tens[t];
}

function convertSubThousands(val) {
const h = Math.floor(val / 100);
const rem = val % 100;
let res = "";
if (h > 0) res += (h === 1 ? "ein" : units[h]) + "hundert";
if (rem > 0) res += convertSubHundreds(rem);
return res;
}

let outputText = "";
let remainingValue = num;

if (remainingValue >= 1000000) {
const mill = Math.floor(remainingValue / 1000000);
remainingValue %= 1000000;
if (mill === 1) outputText += "eine Million";
else outputText += convertSubThousands(mill) + " Millionen";
}

if (remainingValue >= 1000) {
const thous = Math.floor(remainingValue / 1000);
remainingValue %= 1000;
if (thous === 1) outputText += "eintausend";
else outputText += convertSubThousands(thous) + "tausend";
}

if (remainingValue > 0) {
outputText += convertSubThousands(remainingValue);
}

if (outputText.endsWith("eins") && num > 1) {
outputText = outputText.slice(0, -4) + "eins";
}
return outputText;
}

function runLiveIntegerConversionCheck() {
const inputNode = document.getElementById('numerical-matrix-input');
const outputNode = document.getElementById('numerical-matrix-output-string');
if (!inputNode || !outputNode) return;
let val = parseInt(inputNode.value, 10);
if (isNaN(val) || val < 0) {
outputNode.innerText = "Please enter a valid positive integer baseline parameter.";
return;
}
if (val > 100000000) {
outputNode.innerText = "Maximum threshold capped safely at 100,000,000 (100 Million).";
return;
}
outputNode.innerText = generateGermanNumberStringFormula(val);
}

// Real streak tracking: increments once per calendar day, resets after a
// missed day. Previously the counter was stored but never updated.
function registerDailyStreak() {
const today = new Date().toDateString();
const last = localStorage.getItem('sb_last_visit');
if (last === today) return;
const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toDateString();
savedStreakCount = (last === yesterday) ? savedStreakCount + 1 : 1;
localStorage.setItem('sb_streak_count', savedStreakCount);
localStorage.setItem('sb_last_visit', today);
}

// A badge floats up wherever XP is earned, so every part of the app
// visibly feeds the same counter in the header.
function flashXP(amt) {

+ 'font-weight:800;font-size:12px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;pointer-events:none;'

// ---- Levels: XP turns into a visible rank, thresholds widen as you climb ----
const XP_RANKS = [
{ at: 0, title: 'Neuling' }, { at: 150, title: 'Anf\u00e4nger' },
{ at: 400, title: 'Sammler' }, { at: 800, title: 'Kenner' },
{ at: 1400, title: 'Gespr\u00e4chspartner' }, { at: 2200, title: 'Erz\u00e4hler' },
{ at: 3200, title: 'Sprachprofi' }, { at: 4500, title: 'Wortmeister' },
{ at: 6000, title: 'Sprachblitz' }
];
function xpRank(xp) {
let i = 0;
while (i + 1 < XP_RANKS.length && xp >= XP_RANKS[i + 1].at) i++;
const cur = XP_RANKS[i], next = XP_RANKS[i + 1] || null;
const span = next ? next.at - cur.at : Math.max(1, xp - cur.at);
return {
level: i + 1, title: cur.title, next: next,
into: next ? xp - cur.at : span, span: span,
pct: next ? Math.min(100, Math.round(((xp - cur.at) / span) * 100)) : 100
};
}

// ---- Achievements: earned once, stored, announced with a toast ----
const ACHIEVEMENTS = [
{ id:'first_blitz', icon:'\u26a1', label:'First Blitz', desc:'Finish your first Daily Blitz.' },
{ id:'perfect', icon:'\ud83c\udfaf', label:'Perfect round', desc:'Get every question right in one Blitz.' },
{ id:'combo5', icon:'\ud83d\udd25', label:'Five in a row', desc:'Answer five in a row correctly.' },
{ id:'streak3', icon:'\ud83d\udcc5', label:'Three days', desc:'Blitz three days in a row.' },
{ id:'streak7', icon:'\ud83d\uddd3\ufe0f', label:'A full week', desc:'Blitz seven days in a row.' },
{ id:'xp500', icon:'\u2728', label:'500 XP', desc:'Collect 500 XP in total.' },
{ id:'xp2000', icon:'\ud83d\udc8e', label:'2000 XP', desc:'Collect 2000 XP in total.' },
{ id:'ten_lessons', icon:'\ud83d\udcda', label:'Ten lessons', desc:'Complete ten lessons.' },
{ id:'a_place', icon:'\ud83c\udfe0', label:'Room complete', desc:'Finish every lesson of one place.' },
{ id:'listener', icon:'\ud83c\udfa7', label:'Good ear', desc:'Answer ten listening questions correctly.' }
];
let unlockedAchievements = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sb_achievements') || '[]');
let listeningHits = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sb_listen_hits'), 10) || 0;

function hasAchievement(id) { return unlockedAchievements.indexOf(id) !== -1; }

function grantAchievement(id) {
if (hasAchievement(id)) return false;
const a = ACHIEVEMENTS.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!a) return false;
unlockedAchievements.push(id);
localStorage.setItem('sb_achievements', JSON.stringify(unlockedAchievements));
showToast(a.icon, a.label, a.desc);
return true;
}

// Checks everything that can be true right now. Safe to call often.
function checkAchievements(ctx) {
ctx = ctx || {};
const earned = [];
const push = id => { if (grantAchievement(id)) earned.push(id); };
if (ctx.blitzFinished) push('first_blitz');
if (ctx.perfect) push('perfect');
if ((ctx.combo || 0) >= 5) push('combo5');
if (blitzStreak() >= 3) push('streak3');
if (blitzStreak() >= 7) push('streak7');
if (totalXPAmount >= 500) push('xp500');
if (totalXPAmount >= 2000) push('xp2000');
if (Object.keys(lessonProgress).length >= 10) push('ten_lessons');
if (allSceneObjects().some(o => objProgress(o).frac === 1)) push('a_place');
if (listeningHits >= 10) push('listener');
return earned;
}

// One toast at a time, stacked below the header.
function showToast(icon, title, sub) {
if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.body) return;
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.className = 'sb-rise';
el.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size:20px">${icon}</span>
<span style="display:block"><b style="font-size:12px">${title}</b>
<span style="display:block;font-size:10px;opacity:.85">${sub || ''}</span></span>`;
el.style.cssText += ';position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);top:70px;z-index:9999;'
+ 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#1e1b4b;color:#fff;border:1px solid #4338ca;'
+ 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.45);max-width:88%';
document.body.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => { el.style.transition = 'opacity .4s'; el.style.opacity = '0'; }, 2400);
setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 2900);
}

function rewardXP(amt) {
flashXP(amt);

totalXPAmount += amt;
const after = xpRank(totalXPAmount);
if (after.level > before) showToast('\u2b50', 'Level ' + after.level + ' \u00b7 ' + after.title, 'Neuer Rang freigeschaltet');

dailyXP += amt;

updateDashboardTelemetry();
updateGoalRing();

// --- GAME 1: WORD MATCHING MATRIX ENGINE ---
// Practice can be set to A1, A2, or both at once.
let practiceLevel = localStorage.getItem('sb_practice_level') || 'A1';
function setPracticeLevel(lv) {
practiceLevel = lv;
localStorage.setItem('sb_practice_level', lv);
renderActiveTabModule();
}
function practicePool() {
const src = practiceLevel === 'A2' ? a2VocabularyDatabase
: practiceLevel === 'B1' ? b1VocabularyDatabase
: practiceLevel === 'both' ? allVocabularyDatabase
: a1VocabularyDatabase;
const out = [];
Object.keys(src).forEach(c => src[c].forEach(w => out.push(w)));
return out;
}

function initWordMatchGame() {
activeGameMode = 'match';
matchSuccessCount = 0;
matchSelectedGermanIdx = null;
matchSelectedEnglishIdx = null;

// Four random words from whichever level Practice is set to
const pool = practicePool().filter(w => cleanPrompt(w.german).length < 22 && !isCognate(w));
const shuffled = pool.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 4);
const germans = shuffled.map((x, i) => ({ text: x.german, id: i, matched: false }));
const english = shuffled.map((x, i) => ({ text: x.english, id: i, matched: false }));
matchGamePairs = {
germans: germans.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()),
english: english.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random())
};
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function handleMatchSelection(type, idx) {
if (type === 'ger') {
if (matchGamePairs.germans[idx].matched) return;
matchSelectedGermanIdx = idx;
} else {
if (matchGamePairs.english[idx].matched) return;
matchSelectedEnglishIdx = idx;
}

if (matchSelectedGermanIdx !== null && matchSelectedEnglishIdx !== null) {
const gerItem = matchGamePairs.germans[matchSelectedGermanIdx];
const engItem = matchGamePairs.english[matchSelectedEnglishIdx];
if (gerItem.id === engItem.id) {
gerItem.matched = true;
engItem.matched = true;
matchSuccessCount++;
rewardXP(5);
if (matchSuccessCount === 4) rewardXP(10);
}
matchSelectedGermanIdx = null;
matchSelectedEnglishIdx = null;
}
renderActiveTabModule();
}

// --- GAME 2: GENDER BLITZ ARTICLES STRIKER ---
function initGenderBlitzGame() {
activeGameMode = 'gender';
genderGameFeedback = null;

const pool = practicePool().filter(x => ['masculine', 'feminine', 'neuter'].includes(x.gender));
if(pool.length > 0) {
genderGameActiveItem = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function playListeningAudio() {
if (!('speechSynthesis' in window) || typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance === 'undefined') {
alert('Sorry, your browser does not support audio playback. Please try Chrome, Edge, or Safari in a full browser (not an in-app browser).');
return;
}
const lData = currentSkills().listening[activeSkillQuestionIndex % currentSkills().listening.length];
const synth = window.speechSynthesis;
if (synth.speaking) synth.cancel();

const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(lData.transcript);
utterance.lang = 'de-DE';
utterance.rate = 0.85;
utterance.volume = 1;
const voices = synth.getVoices();
const germanVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang === 'de-DE') || voices.find(v => v.lang && v.lang.startsWith('de'));
if (germanVoice) utterance.voice = germanVoice;
utterance.onerror = (e) => {
console.error('Speech synthesis error:', e.error);
alert('Audio playback failed (' + e.error + '). Check your device volume/silent mode, or try opening this page directly in Chrome or Safari instead of an in-app browser.');
};
// Call speak() synchronously within the click handler - required by
// Safari/iOS, which blocks speech that isn't directly tied to a tap.
synth.speak(utterance);
}

function cleanupFallbackRecording() {

function escapeHtmlForField(str) {

}

// --- A1 E-Mail Writing Auto-Checker (heuristic grammar/content/style feedback) ---
function checkEmailWriting() {
const wData = currentSkills().writing[activeSkillQuestionIndex % currentSkills().writing.length];
const text = writingUserText.trim();
const lower = text.toLowerCase();
const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
const wordCount = words.length;

const salutations = ['liebe ', 'lieber ', 'hallo', 'sehr geehrte', 'sehr geehrter', 'guten morgen', 'guten tag'];
const first60 = lower.slice(0, 60);
const hasSalutation = salutations.some(s => first60.includes(s));

const closings = ['viele grüße', 'liebe grüße', 'beste grüße', 'herzliche grüße', 'freundliche grüße', 'mit freundlichen grüßen', 'lg ', 'bis bald', 'dein ', 'deine '];
const last80 = lower.slice(-80);
const hasClosing = closings.some(s => last80.includes(s));

const pointsCovered = wData.pointKeywords.map(variants => variants.some(v => lower.includes(v)));
const coveredCount = pointsCovered.filter(Boolean).length;

const hasEndPunctuation = /[.!?]\s*$/.test(text);
const doubleSpace = / {2,}/.test(text);
const missingSpaceAfterPunct = /[.,!?][A-Za-zÄÖÜäöü]/.test(text);

const grammarRules = [
{ p: /\bich haben\b/i, tip: "Nach 'ich' heißt es 'ich habe', nicht 'ich haben'." },
{ p: /\bich (sind|seid)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'ich' heißt es 'ich bin'." },
{ p: /\bdu (habe|hat|habt|haben)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'du' heißt es 'du hast'." },
{ p: /\bdu (bin|ist|sind|seid)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'du' heißt es 'du bist'." },
{ p: /\ber (habe|hast|habt|haben)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'er/sie/es' heißt es 'er/sie/es hat'." },
{ p: /\bwir (bin|bist|ist|seid)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'wir' heißt es 'wir sind'." },
{ p: /\bwir (habe|hast|hat|habt)\b/i, tip: "Nach 'wir' heißt es 'wir haben'." },
{ p: /\bich kannst\b/i, tip: "Nach 'ich' heißt es 'ich kann', nicht 'ich kannst'." },
{ p: /\bich möchtest\b/i, tip: "Nach 'ich' heißt es 'ich möchte', nicht 'ich möchtest'." },
{ p: /\bich wollen\b/i, tip: "Nach 'ich' heißt es 'ich will', nicht 'ich wollen'." }
];
const grammarIssues = grammarRules.filter(r => r.p.test(text)).map(r => r.tip);

let score = 0;
score += coveredCount * 20;
if (hasSalutation) score += 15;
if (hasClosing) score += 15;
if (wordCount >= wData.minWords && wordCount <= wData.maxWords) score += 10;
else if (wordCount >= Math.max(5, wData.minWords - 5)) score += 5;
score -= grammarIssues.length * 5;
if (doubleSpace) score -= 3;
if (missingSpaceAfterPunct) score -= 3;
if (!hasEndPunctuation) score -= 5;
score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));

writingCheckResult = {
wordCount, hasSalutation, hasClosing, pointsCovered, coveredCount,
hasEndPunctuation, doubleSpace, missingSpaceAfterPunct, grammarIssues, score
};

if (!writingSubmitted) {
writingSubmitted = true;
recordSkillHit('writing', score >= 70);
let xp = 3;
if (score >= 70) xp = 15;
else if (score >= 40) xp = 8;
rewardXP(xp);
writingCheckResult.xpAwarded = xp;
}

renderActiveTabModule();
}

function toggleSkillWritingSample() {
skillWritingShowSample = !skillWritingShowSample;
renderActiveTabModule();
}

// --- Speaking Pronunciation Check via Browser Microphone (Web Speech API) ---
function normalizeGermanForMatch(str) {
return String(str).toLowerCase()
.replace(/[.,!?;:"'„“]/g, '')
.replace(/ß/g, 'ss')
.replace(/ä/g, 'ae').replace(/ö/g, 'oe').replace(/ü/g, 'ue')
.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
.trim();
}

function computeSpeechMatchScore(target, spoken) {
const t = normalizeGermanForMatch(target).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
const s = normalizeGermanForMatch(spoken).split(' ').filter(Boolean);
if (t.length === 0) return 0;
const sCopy = s.slice();
let matched = 0;
t.forEach(word => {
const idx = sCopy.indexOf(word);
if (idx !== -1) { matched++; sCopy.splice(idx, 1); }
});
return matched / t.length;
}

function getSpeechRecognitionAPI() {
return window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition || null;
}

function isSpeechRecognitionSupported() {
// iOS/iPadOS browsers (Safari, and every other browser on iOS, since
// they all run on WebKit under Apple's rules) do not implement the
// SpeechRecognition Web API at all, regardless of vendor prefix checks.
const ua = (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.userAgent) || '';
const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) || (ua.includes('Macintosh') && typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
return !!getSpeechRecognitionAPI() && !isIOS;
}

function runSpeechRecognitionPass(sData) {
const SpeechRecognitionAPI = getSpeechRecognitionAPI();
const recognition = new SpeechRecognitionAPI();
recognition.lang = 'de-DE';
recognition.interimResults = false;
recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;

let settled = false;

recognition.onresult = (event) => {
settled = true;
const transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
speakingRecognizedText = transcript;
const score = computeSpeechMatchScore(sData.text, transcript);
if (score >= 0.75) speakingFeedback = 'correct';
else if (score >= 0.4) speakingFeedback = 'partial';
else speakingFeedback = 'incorrect';

recordSkillHit('speaking', speakingFeedback === 'correct');
if (speakingFeedback === 'correct' && !speakingXPAwarded) {
speakingXPAwarded = true;
rewardXP(10);
}
speakingRecognitionActive = false;
renderActiveTabModule();
};

recognition.onerror = (event) => {
settled = true;
speakingRecognitionActive = false;
if (event.error === 'no-speech') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Es wurde keine Sprache erkannt. Bitte versuchen Sie es noch einmal und sprechen Sie direkt nach dem Antippen des Knopfes.';
} else if (event.error === 'not-allowed' || event.error === 'audio-capture' || event.error === 'service-not-allowed') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Kein Zugriff auf das Mikrofon. Bitte erlauben Sie den Mikrofonzugriff in den Browser-Einstellungen für diese Seite und laden Sie die Seite neu.';
} else if (event.error === 'network') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Netzwerkfehler bei der Spracherkennung. Bitte prüfen Sie Ihre Internetverbindung.';
} else {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Fehler bei der Spracherkennung (' + event.error + '). Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut.';
}
renderActiveTabModule();
};

recognition.onend = () => {
if (!settled && speakingRecognitionActive) {
// Recognition ended without ever firing onresult/onerror
speakingRecognitionActive = false;
speakingErrorMessage = 'Es wurde nichts aufgenommen. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut und sprechen Sie deutlich in das Mikrofon.';
renderActiveTabModule();
}
};

try {
recognition.start();
} catch (e) {
speakingRecognitionActive = false;
speakingErrorMessage = 'Spracherkennung konnte nicht gestartet werden: ' + e.message;
renderActiveTabModule();
}
}

function startSpeakingRecognition() {
speakingErrorMessage = null;

if (!isSpeechRecognitionSupported()) {
speakingErrorMessage = getSpeechRecognitionAPI()
? 'Ihr Gerät unterstützt leider keine Spracherkennung im Browser (iOS/iPadOS schränkt diese Funktion für alle Browser ein). Bitte probieren Sie diese Übung auf einem Android-Gerät oder einem Desktop-Computer mit Chrome oder Edge.'
: 'Ihr Browser unterstützt keine Spracherkennung. Bitte verwenden Sie Chrome oder Edge auf einem Android-Gerät oder Desktop-Computer.';
renderActiveTabModule();
return;
}

const sData = currentSkills().speaking[activeSkillQuestionIndex % currentSkills().speaking.length];
speakingRecognitionActive = true;
speakingRecognizedText = null;
speakingFeedback = null;
renderActiveTabModule();

// Explicitly request microphone permission first so we get a clear,
// reliable prompt and error reason, then run the recognition pass.
if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
.then((stream) => {
stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
runSpeechRecognitionPass(sData);
})
.catch((err) => {
speakingRecognitionActive = false;
const name = err && err.name;
if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'PermissionDeniedError' || name === 'SecurityError') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Der Mikrofonzugriff ist für diese Seite blockiert. Tippen Sie auf das Schloss-/Info-Symbol links neben der Adresse, öffnen Sie "Berechtigungen" bzw. "Website-Einstellungen" und stellen Sie Mikrofon auf "Zulassen". Prüfen Sie zusätzlich unter Android-Einstellungen → Apps → Chrome → Berechtigungen, ob Mikrofon dort erlaubt ist. Laden Sie die Seite danach neu.';
} else if (name === 'NotFoundError' || name === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Es wurde kein Mikrofon gefunden.';
} else if (name === 'NotReadableError' || name === 'TrackStartError') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Das Mikrofon wird gerade von einer anderen App verwendet. Bitte schließen Sie andere Apps, die das Mikrofon nutzen, und versuchen Sie es erneut.';
} else {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Kein Zugriff auf das Mikrofon (' + (name || 'unbekannter Fehler') + '). Bitte prüfen Sie die Mikrofon-Berechtigung für diese Seite und laden Sie die Seite neu.';
}
renderActiveTabModule();
});
} else {
runSpeechRecognitionPass(sData);
}
}

// --- Fallback: Record & Self-Check (for Safari on iPhone/iPad/Mac and
// any other browser without SpeechRecognition support). Uses
// MediaRecorder, which Safari DOES support, unlike SpeechRecognition. ---
function hasMediaRecorderSupport() {
return !!(navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia && window.MediaRecorder);
}

function startFallbackRecording() {
speakingErrorMessage = null;
if (!hasMediaRecorderSupport()) {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Aufnahme wird auf diesem Gerät nicht unterstützt.';
renderActiveTabModule();
return;
}
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
.then((stream) => {
fallbackMediaStreamObj = stream;
fallbackAudioChunks = [];
const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
fallbackMediaRecorderObj = recorder;

recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) fallbackAudioChunks.push(e.data);
};
recorder.onstop = () => {
const blob = new Blob(fallbackAudioChunks, { type: fallbackAudioChunks[0] && fallbackAudioChunks[0].type ? fallbackAudioChunks[0].type : 'audio/webm' });
if (fallbackAudioUrl) { try { URL.revokeObjectURL(fallbackAudioUrl); } catch (e) {} }
fallbackAudioUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
fallbackRecordingActive = false;
if (fallbackMediaStreamObj) {
fallbackMediaStreamObj.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
fallbackMediaStreamObj = null;
}
renderActiveTabModule();
};

recorder.start();
fallbackRecordingActive = true;
fallbackAudioUrl = null;
fallbackSelfAssessed = false;
renderActiveTabModule();
})
.catch((err) => {
const name = err && err.name;
if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'PermissionDeniedError' || name === 'SecurityError') {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Der Mikrofonzugriff ist blockiert. Bitte erlauben Sie den Mikrofonzugriff für diese Seite in den Browser-Einstellungen und laden Sie die Seite neu.';
} else {
speakingErrorMessage = 'Kein Zugriff auf das Mikrofon (' + (name || 'unbekannter Fehler') + ').';
}
renderActiveTabModule();
});
}

function stopFallbackRecording() {
if (fallbackMediaRecorderObj && fallbackMediaRecorderObj.state !== 'inactive') {
fallbackMediaRecorderObj.stop();
}
}

function markFallbackSelfAssessed() {
fallbackSelfAssessed = true;
recordSkillHit('speaking', true);
if (!fallbackXPAwarded) {
fallbackXPAwarded = true;
rewardXP(5);
}
renderActiveTabModule();
}

// ===== Grammatik-Blitz: one random exercise from the level's grammar banks =====
let grammarBlitzItem = null;
let grammarBlitzPicked = null;

function grammarBankIds() {
const keys = Object.keys(grammarExercises);
if (practiceLevel === 'A2') return keys.filter(k => k.startsWith('a2_'));
if (practiceLevel === 'B1') return keys.filter(k => k.startsWith('b1_'));
if (practiceLevel === 'both') return keys;
return keys.filter(k => !k.startsWith('a2_') && !k.startsWith('b1_'));
}

function initGrammarBlitz() {
activeGameMode = 'grammar';
grammarBlitzPicked = null;
const ids = grammarBankIds();
if (!ids.length) { activeGameMode = 'none'; renderActiveTabModule(); return; }
const gid = ids[Math.floor(Math.random() * ids.length)];
const bank = grammarExercises[gid];
grammarBlitzItem = Object.assign({}, bank[Math.floor(Math.random() * bank.length)], { gid });
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function answerGrammarBlitz(i) {
if (grammarBlitzPicked !== null) return;
grammarBlitzPicked = i;
if (i === grammarBlitzItem.correct) rewardXP(5);
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function submitGenderStrikeAnswer(chosenGender) {
if (genderGameFeedback !== null) return;
if (genderGameActiveItem.gender === chosenGender) {
genderGameFeedback = 'correct';
rewardXP(5);
} else {
genderGameFeedback = 'wrong';
}
renderActiveTabModule();
}

const skillLabels = { listening: 'H\u00f6ren', reading: 'Lesen', writing: 'Schreiben', speaking: 'Sprechen' };

function readinessColour(pct) {
if (pct >= 70) return '#10b981';
if (pct >= 40) return '#f59e0b';
return '#f43f5e';
}

function renderExamPanel(conf, goalPct, doneCount, totalLessons) {
const days = daysUntilExam();
const ready = overallReadiness();
const skills = ['listening','reading','writing','speaking'];

const bars = skills.map(sk => {
const pct = skillReadiness(sk);
return `
<div>
<div class="flex justify-between items-baseline mb-1">
<span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">${skillLabels[sk]}</span>
<span class="text-[10px] font-black" style="color:${readinessColour(pct)}">${pct}%</span>
</div>
<div class="h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
<div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all" style="width:${pct}%; background:${readinessColour(pct)}"></div>
</div>
</div>`;
}).join('');

const header = days === null
? `<button onclick="document.getElementById('exam-date-input').showPicker ? document.getElementById('exam-date-input').showPicker() : document.getElementById('exam-date-input').focus()" class="text-[11px] font-black text-indigo-400">Pr\u00fcfungstermin setzen \u2192</button>`
: (days >= 0
? `<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400">Pr\u00fcfung in <span class="text-white font-black">${days}</span> ${days === 1 ? 'Tag' : 'Tagen'}</span>`
: `<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">Pr\u00fcfungstermin vorbei</span>`);

return `
<div class="${conf.cardBg} border p-4 rounded-2xl space-y-3">
<div class="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
<span class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500">Pr\u00fcfungsplan A1</span>
${header}
</div>
<div class="flex items-end gap-3">
<img src="./bears/bear-stand.png" alt="" class="h-14 w-auto shrink-0">
<div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
<p class="text-3xl font-black leading-none" style="color:${readinessColour(ready)}">${ready}%</p>
<p class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-0.5">bereit \u00b7 ${doneCount}/${totalLessons} Lektionen</p>
</div>
<div class="text-right shrink-0">
<p class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">heute</p>
<p class="text-sm font-black ${goalPct>=100?'text-emerald-400':'text-amber-400'}">${dailyXP}/${DAILY_GOAL_XP} XP</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-3 gap-y-2 pt-1">${bars}</div>
<input type="date" id="exam-date-input" value="${examDate}" onchange="setExamDate(this.value)" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 outline-none">
</div>`;
}

function lessonById(id) { return flatLessons().find(l => l.id === id); }
function objProgress(obj) {
const done = obj.lessons.filter(id => isLessonDone(id)).length;
return { done, total: obj.lessons.length, frac: obj.lessons.length ? done / obj.lessons.length : 0 };
}
function suggestedObjectId() {
for (const o of sceneObjects()) { if (objProgress(o).frac < 1) return o.id; }
return null;
}

function timeOfDay() {
const h = new Date().getHours();
if (h < 6) return 'night';
if (h < 11) return 'morning';
if (h < 17) return 'day';
if (h < 21) return 'evening';
return 'night';
}

morning: { sky:"#bfe3f5", sun:"#ffe9a8", wall:"#f6e7d2", wallDark:"#e8d3b8", floor:"#c79a6b", glow:"#fff3d6", label:"Guten Morgen" },
day: { sky:"#a8d8f0", sun:"#fff6cf", wall:"#f7ecdc", wallDark:"#ead9c2", floor:"#c9a074", glow:"#fff8e6", label:"Guten Tag" },
evening: { sky:"#f2b98a", sun:"#ffcf95", wall:"#e8cdb4", wallDark:"#d4b295", floor:"#a9835c", glow:"#ffdca8", label:"Guten Abend" },
night: { sky:"#1e2a4a", sun:"#dbe6ff", wall:"#5b5573", wallDark:"#3a3550", floor:"#4a3b52", glow:"#ffd98a", label:"Gute Nacht" }
};

// ===== Seasons: drives the window view, a colour wash and falling particles =====
function seasonNow() {
const m = new Date().getMonth(); // 0 = January
if (m === 11 || m < 2) return 'winter';
if (m < 5) return 'spring';
if (m < 8) return 'summer';
return 'autumn';
}

const seasonProfiles = {
winter: { de:'Winter', en:'Winter', tint:'#cfe6ff', tintA:.20, hill:'#eef4fb', tree:'#7d9bb5', leaf:'#ffffff',
particle:'snow', note:'Es schneit.' },
spring: { de:'Fr\u00fchling', en:'Spring', tint:'#d8f3d0', tintA:.16, hill:'#a8d99a', tree:'#5f9e57', leaf:'#f7b8d8',
particle:'petal', note:'Die Blumen bl\u00fchen.' },
summer: { de:'Sommer', en:'Summer', tint:'#ffe9a8', tintA:.14, hill:'#8fc96f', tree:'#3f8b46', leaf:'#ffd447',
particle:'none', note:'Es ist warm.' },
autumn: { de:'Herbst', en:'Autumn', tint:'#ffd9a8', tintA:.18, hill:'#c9a45e', tree:'#a4632c', leaf:'#e07b39',
particle:'leaf', note:'Die Bl\u00e4tter fallen.' }
};

// Falling snow / petals / leaves, drawn as SVG so no images are needed
function seasonParticles(sp) {
if (typeof reduceMotion !== 'undefined' && reduceMotion) return '';
if (sp.particle === 'none') return '';
const n = sp.particle === 'snow' ? 16 : 10;
let out = '';
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
const x = 6 + (i * 37) % 388;
const dur = (6 + (i % 5) * 1.6).toFixed(1);
const delay = ((i * 0.7) % 6).toFixed(1);
const r = sp.particle === 'snow' ? 2.2 : 3.2;
const shape = sp.particle === 'snow'
? `<circle r="${r}" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".85"/>`
: `<ellipse rx="${r}" ry="${r*0.6}" fill="${sp.leaf}" opacity=".85"/>`;
out += `<g transform="translate(${x},-10)">${shape}
<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" additive="sum"
values="0,-10; ${(i%2?14:-14)},300" dur="${dur}s" begin="${delay}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" additive="sum"
values="0;360" dur="${dur}s" begin="${delay}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
</g>`;
}
return `<g pointer-events="none">${out}</g>`;
}

// Bruno's spot in the room: {left%, bottom%, height%, pose}

// Where Bruno stands in the room, and which pose, depending on the hour.
// Morning by the kitchen table, daytime at his desk, evening thinking,
// night asleep in bed. A good day's work makes him dance on the rug.
function brunoInRoom() {
const t = timeOfDay();
const learnedToday = dailyXP >= 20;
// Bruno stands centre-stage on the rug. Only the night pose moves him
// over to the bed, because that is where sleeping makes sense.
if (t === 'night') return { pose:'bear-sleep', x:700, y:250, h:92 };
if (learnedToday) return { pose:'bear-dance', x:404, y:268, h:132 };
if (t === 'morning') return { pose:'bear-stand', x:412, y:262, h:138 };
if (t === 'day') return { pose:'bear-sit', x:410, y:282, h:118 };
return { pose:'bear-think', x:412, y:262, h:138 };
}

// Pose shown on a corner sheet, reacting to how far along that corner is
function brunoForCorner(frac) {
if (frac === 1) return 'bear-jump';
if (frac > 0) return 'bear-walk';
return 'bear-think';
}

function roomBearPose() {
const t = timeOfDay();
if (t === 'night') return 'bear-sleep';
if (dailyXP >= DAILY_GOAL_XP) return 'bear-dance';
if (dailyXP > 0) return 'bear-sit';
if (t === 'morning') return 'bear-wave';
return 'bear-stand';
}

function bearGreeting() {
const pal = roomPalettes[timeOfDay()];
const learned = sceneObjects().filter(o => objProgress(o).frac === 1).length;
if (learned === 0) return "Hallo!";
if (learned < 3) return pal.label + "!";
if (learned < 6) return pal.label + "! Wie geht's?";
return pal.label + "! Sch\u00f6n, dass du da bist.";
}

return brunoMoments[day % brunoMoments.length];
}

// ---- Accounts (Firebase). Shows a clear message while the project keys
// in sb-auth.js are still placeholders. ----
let authMode = 'signin'; // 'signin' | 'signup'
let authEmail = '', authPass = '', authName = '', authMsg = '';

function sbAuthError(e) {
const map = {
'auth/invalid-email': 'Diese E-Mail-Adresse ist ung\u00fcltig.',
'auth/missing-password': 'Bitte gib ein Passwort ein.',
'auth/weak-password': 'Das Passwort braucht mindestens 6 Zeichen.',
'auth/email-already-in-use': 'F\u00fcr diese E-Mail gibt es schon ein Konto. Melde dich an.',
'auth/invalid-credential': 'E-Mail oder Passwort stimmt nicht.',
'auth/popup-blocked': 'Das Anmeldefenster wurde blockiert. Bitte Pop-ups erlauben.',
'auth/popup-closed-by-user': 'Anmeldung abgebrochen.',
'auth/unauthorized-domain': 'Diese Domain ist in Firebase nicht freigegeben.'
};
authMsg = map[e && e.code] || ('Fehler: ' + ((e && e.code) || e));
renderActiveTabModule();
}
function sbAuthNotice(m) { authMsg = m; renderActiveTabModule(); }
function setAuthMode(m) { authMode = m; authMsg = ''; renderActiveTabModule(); }
function setAuthField(which, v) {
if (which === 'email') authEmail = v;
else if (which === 'pass') authPass = v;
else authName = v;
}
function submitAuthForm() {
authMsg = '';
if (authMode === 'signup') sbCreateAccount();
else sbSignInEmail(authEmail, authPass);
}

localStorage.setItem('sb_sync_prompt_off', '1');
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function sbSyncPromptHTML() {
const ready = (typeof sbAuthReady === 'function') && sbAuthReady();
if (!ready || window.sbUser) return '';

const lessons = Object.keys(lessonProgress).length;

return `

Du hast schon ${totalXPAmount} XP gesammelt. Mit einem Konto bleibt dein Fortschritt
erhalten \u2013 auch auf dem Handy oder nach dem L\u00f6schen des Browsers.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>`;
}

function sbAccountBlockHTML() {
const ready = (typeof sbAuthReady === 'function') && sbAuthReady();
if (!ready) {
return `
<div class="rounded-2xl p-4" style="background:#1e293b">
<p class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider od-muted">Konto</p>
<p class="text-[11px] font-bold od-dim mt-1 leading-relaxed">
Cloud-Konten sind noch nicht eingerichtet. Trage die Firebase-Zugangsdaten
in <b>sb-auth.js</b> ein, dann erscheint hier die Anmeldung.</p>
</div>`;
}

const u = window.sbUser;
if (u) {
return `

<p class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider od-muted">Konto</p>

<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">

<button onclick="sbSignOut()" class="btn3d py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-black text-white" style="background:#7f1d1d">Abmelden</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
// Check if user is logged in
if (window.currentUser && !window.currentUser.isAnonymous) {
return `

<p class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider od-muted">✅ KONTO</p>

📧 <strong>${window.currentUser.email}</strong>
</p>

Logout
</button>

}

return `

${authMode === 'signup' ? `

<button onclick="submitAuthForm()" class="btn3d w-full py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-black text-white" style="background:#4f46e5">

${authMode === 'signin' ? `<button onclick="sbResetPassword(authEmail)" class="text-[10px] font-black od-muted">Passwort vergessen?</button>` : ''}
</div>
${authMsg ? `<p class="text-[11px] font-bold od-amber pt-1">${authMsg}</p>` : ''}
</div>
`;
// Logout defined globally after Firebase imports
}

`<option value="${k}" ${k === currentThemeProfile ? 'selected' : ''}>${k.replace(/-/g, ' ')}</option>`).join('')}
</select>`)}
</div>

${sbAccountBlockHTML()}

<div class="rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2" style="background:#1e293b">
<p class="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider od-muted">Your progress</p>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
<button onclick="exportProgress()" class="btn3d py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-black text-white" style="background:#334155">Export to file</button>
<label class="btn3d py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-black text-white text-center cursor-pointer" style="background:#334155">
Import file
<input type="file" accept="application/json" onchange="importProgress(this)" class="hidden">
</label>
</div>
<button onclick="resetProgress()" class="btn3d w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-black text-white" style="background:#7f1d1d">Delete all progress</button>
<p class="text-[10px] font-bold od-dim">Sprachblitz ${APP_BUILD} \u00b7 ${totalXPAmount} XP \u00b7 ${daysLearned} ${daysLearned === 1 ? 'Tag' : 'Tage'} gelernt</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>`;
}

// ===================== Profile, settings, Daily Blitz =====================
// There is no server behind this app, so there is no account and no password.
// "Profile" means a name and an avatar stored on this device only, and the
// settings sheet is where a learner changes how the app behaves.
let settingsOpen = false;
let learnerName = localStorage.getItem('sb_name') || '';
let learnerAvatar = localStorage.getItem('sb_avatar') || '🐻';
let soundOn = localStorage.getItem('sb_sound') !== '0';
let speechRate = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('sb_speech_rate')) || 0.85;
let reduceMotion = localStorage.getItem('sb_reduce_motion') === '1';

const AVATAR_CHOICES = ['🐻','🦊','🦉','🐼','🐨','🦁','🐧','🐢'];

function openSettings() { settingsOpen = true; renderActiveTabModule(); }
function closeSettings() { settingsOpen = false; renderActiveTabModule(); }

function saveLearnerName(v) {
learnerName = String(v || '').slice(0, 24);
localStorage.setItem('sb_name', learnerName);
updateDashboardTelemetry();
}
function setAvatar(a) {
learnerAvatar = a;
localStorage.setItem('sb_avatar', a);
const node = document.getElementById('header-avatar');
if (node) node.innerText = a;
renderActiveTabModule();
}
function setSoundOn(v) {
soundOn = !!v;
localStorage.setItem('sb_sound', soundOn ? '1' : '0');
if (!soundOn && 'speechSynthesis' in window) { try { window.speechSynthesis.cancel(); } catch (e) {} }
renderActiveTabModule();
}
function setSpeechRate(v) {
speechRate = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.5, parseFloat(v) || 0.85));
localStorage.setItem('sb_speech_rate', speechRate);
const lab = document.getElementById('rate-label');
if (lab) lab.innerText = speechRate.toFixed(2) + '\u00d7';
}
function setReduceMotion(v) {
reduceMotion = !!v;
localStorage.setItem('sb_reduce_motion', reduceMotion ? '1' : '0');
renderActiveTabModule();
}

// Everything the app knows about this learner, as a file they can keep.
function exportProgress() {
const data = {};
for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
const k = localStorage.key(i);
if (k && k.indexOf('sb_') === 0) data[k] = localStorage.getItem(k);
}
const payload = { app: 'Sprachblitz', build: APP_BUILD, exported: new Date().toISOString(), data };
const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
a.download = 'sprachblitz-progress.json';
a.click();
setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
}

function importProgress(input) {
const file = input && input.files && input.files[0];
if (!file) return;
const reader = new FileReader();
reader.onload = () => {
try {
const parsed = JSON.parse(reader.result);
if (!parsed || !parsed.data) throw new Error('not a Sprachblitz file');
Object.entries(parsed.data).forEach(([k, v]) => {
if (k.indexOf('sb_') === 0) localStorage.setItem(k, v);
});
location.reload();
} catch (e) {
alert('That file could not be read as Sprachblitz progress.');
}
};
reader.readAsText(file);
}

function resetProgress() {
if (!confirm('Delete all progress on this device? This cannot be undone.')) return;
const keys = [];
for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
const k = localStorage.key(i);
if (k && k.indexOf('sb_') === 0) keys.push(k);
}
keys.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
location.reload();
}

// ---- Daily Blitz: one obvious thing to do, five questions, once a day ----
let blitzQuestions = [], blitzIndex = 0, blitzPicked = null, blitzCorrect = 0, blitzDone = false;
let blitzCombo = 0, blitzBestCombo = 0, blitzSessionXP = 0, blitzEarned = [], blitzFeedbackClass = '';
const BLITZ_LENGTH = 5;

function blitzDoneToday() {
return localStorage.getItem('sb_blitz_date') === new Date().toDateString();
}
function blitzStreak() {
return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('sb_blitz_streak'), 10) || 0;
}

// Mixes vocabulary from the active level with grammar drills already unlocked,
// so the Blitz always reviews what this learner has actually met.
function buildBlitzQuestions() {
const out = [];
const dbForLevel = { A1: a1VocabularyDatabase, A2: a2VocabularyDatabase, B1: b1VocabularyDatabase, B2: b2VocabularyDatabase };
const pool = Object.values(dbForLevel[activeLevel] || a1VocabularyDatabase).flat();
shuffle(pool).slice(0, 3).forEach(w => {
// Two words in a level can share an English gloss, which would put the
// same option in the list twice - so distractors are deduplicated.
const seen = new Set([w.english]);
const wrong = [];
shuffle(pool).forEach(x => {
if (wrong.length >= 3 || seen.has(x.english)) return;
seen.add(x.english); wrong.push(x);
});
const opts = shuffle([w.english].concat(wrong.map(x => x.english)));
out.push({
kind: 'vocab',
prompt: cleanPrompt(w.german),
speak: w.german,
ask: 'What does this mean?',
options: opts,
correct: opts.indexOf(w.english),
explain: w.hint || ''
});
});
// One question is audio-only: nothing to read, you have to listen.
const heard = shuffle(pool).find(w => w.german && w.german.length < 26);
if (heard) {
const seenG = new Set([heard.german]);
const distract = [];
shuffle(pool).forEach(x => {
if (distract.length >= 3 || seenG.has(x.german)) return;
seenG.add(x.german); distract.push(x);
});
const opts = shuffle([heard.german].concat(distract.map(x => x.german)));
out.push({
kind: 'listen', prompt: '\ud83c\udfa7', speak: heard.german,
ask: 'Listen \u2014 which word is it?',
options: opts, correct: opts.indexOf(heard.german),
explain: heard.english ? heard.german + ' = ' + heard.english : ''
});
}

const gids = curriculumUnits
.filter(u => u.level === activeLevel)
.flatMap(u => u.lessons.filter(l => l.type === 'grammar').map(l => l.gid))
.filter(g => grammarExercises[g]);
shuffle(gids).slice(0, BLITZ_LENGTH - out.length).forEach(g => {
const q = grammarExercises[g][Math.floor(Math.random() * grammarExercises[g].length)];
out.push({
kind: 'grammar', prompt: q.prompt, speak: null, ask: q.ask,
options: q.options, correct: q.correct, explain: q.explain
});
});
return shuffle(out).slice(0, BLITZ_LENGTH);
}

function startDailyBlitz() {
blitzQuestions = buildBlitzQuestions();
if (!blitzQuestions.length) return;
blitzIndex = 0; blitzPicked = null; blitzCorrect = 0; blitzDone = false;
blitzCombo = 0; blitzBestCombo = 0; blitzSessionXP = 0; blitzEarned = []; blitzFeedbackClass = '';
activeGameMode = 'blitz';
renderActiveTabModule();
speakBlitzPromptIfNeeded();
}

// Audio questions play themselves; written ones stay silent.
function speakBlitzPromptIfNeeded() {
const q = blitzQuestions[blitzIndex];
if (q && q.kind === 'listen' && q.speak) setTimeout(() => speakGerman(q.speak, true), 260);
}

// Answering correctly in a row is worth more: 4 XP, rising to 8 on a run.
function blitzXPFor(combo) { return Math.min(8, 4 + Math.max(0, combo - 1)); }

function answerBlitz(i) {
if (blitzPicked !== null) return;
blitzPicked = i;
const q = blitzQuestions[blitzIndex];
if (i === q.correct) {
blitzCorrect++;
blitzCombo++;
blitzBestCombo = Math.max(blitzBestCombo, blitzCombo);
const gain = blitzXPFor(blitzCombo);
blitzSessionXP += gain;
blitzFeedbackClass = 'sb-pop';
rewardXP(gain);
if (q.kind === 'listen') {
listeningHits++;
localStorage.setItem('sb_listen_hits', listeningHits);
}
blitzEarned = blitzEarned.concat(checkAchievements({ combo: blitzCombo }));
} else {
blitzCombo = 0;
blitzFeedbackClass = 'sb-shake';
// Hearing the right answer matters more than reading it.
if (q.speak) setTimeout(() => speakGerman(q.speak, true), 200);
}
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function nextBlitz() {
if (blitzIndex < blitzQuestions.length - 1) {
blitzIndex++; blitzPicked = null; blitzFeedbackClass = '';
renderActiveTabModule();
speakBlitzPromptIfNeeded();
return;
}
blitzDone = true;
const today = new Date().toDateString();
if (localStorage.getItem('sb_blitz_date') !== today) {
const yest = new Date(Date.now() - 864e5).toDateString();
const run = localStorage.getItem('sb_blitz_date') === yest ? blitzStreak() + 1 : 1;
localStorage.setItem('sb_blitz_streak', run);
localStorage.setItem('sb_blitz_date', today);
// Completion bonus grows with the run, capped so a long streak
// stays a reward rather than a reason not to miss a day.
const bonus = 10 + Math.min(run, 7) * 2;
blitzSessionXP += bonus;
rewardXP(bonus);
}
const perfect = blitzCorrect === blitzQuestions.length;
blitzEarned = blitzEarned.concat(checkAchievements({
blitzFinished: true, perfect: perfect, combo: blitzBestCombo
}));
renderActiveTabModule();
}

// ---- Achievements shelf, opened from the dashboard level bar ----
let achievementsOpen = false;
function openAchievements() { achievementsOpen = true; renderActiveTabModule(); }
function closeAchievements() { achievementsOpen = false; renderActiveTabModule(); }

function achievementsSheetHTML() {
if (!achievementsOpen) return '';
const rank = xpRank(totalXPAmount);
return `
<div onclick="closeAchievements()" style="position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(2,6,23,.72);z-index:9997"></div>
<div class="sb-rise" style="position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:9998;max-height:78vh;overflow-y:auto;
background:#0f172a;border-top:1px solid #1e293b;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;padding:18px">

<div>
<p class="text-sm font-black text-white">Level ${rank.level} \u00b7 <span translate="no" lang="de">${rank.title}</span></p>
<p class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400">${totalXPAmount} XP total${rank.next ? ' \u00b7 ' + (rank.next.at - totalXPAmount) + ' XP to ' + rank.next.title : ''}</p>

</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
${ACHIEVEMENTS.map(a => {
const got = hasAchievement(a.id);
return `<div class="rounded-xl p-3" style="background:${got ? '#1e1b4b' : '#0b1220'};border:1px solid ${got ? '#4338ca' : '#1e293b'};opacity:${got ? 1 : .55}">
<p class="text-xl">${got ? a.icon : '\ud83d\udd12'}</p>
<p class="text-[11px] font-black text-white mt-1">${a.label}</p>
<p class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">${a.desc}</p>
</div>`;

</div>
</div>`;
}

// ---- A1 -> A2 -> B1 -> B2: suggest the next level once this one is mostly done ----
const LEVEL_ORDER = ['A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2'];
function levelCompletion(lv) {
const lessons = curriculumUnits.filter(u => u.level === lv).flatMap(u => u.lessons);
if (!lessons.length) return 0;
const done = lessons.filter(l => lessonProgress[l.id]).length;
return done / lessons.length;
}
function nextLevelSuggestion() {
const i = LEVEL_ORDER.indexOf(activeLevel);
const next = LEVEL_ORDER[i + 1];
if (!next) return null;
const pct = levelCompletion(activeLevel);
if (pct < 0.8) return null;
if (localStorage.getItem('sb_level_prompt_' + next) === 'seen') return null;
return { next: next, pct: Math.round(pct * 100) };
}
function acceptNextLevel(lv) {
localStorage.setItem('sb_level_prompt_' + lv, 'seen');
setLevel(lv);
showToast('\ud83d\uddfa\ufe0f', lv + ' freigeschaltet', 'Ein neuer Ort wartet auf dich.');
}
function dismissNextLevel(lv) {
localStorage.setItem('sb_level_prompt_' + lv, 'seen');
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function journalUnlockedCount() {
const learned = sceneObjects().filter(o => objProgress(o).frac === 1).length;
return journalEntries.filter(e => e.need <= learned).length;
}

// Full grammatical picture for a vocabulary entry: article, indefinite
// form, and a plain-language note on what kind of word it is.
const genderInfo = {
masculine: { def:'der', indef:'ein', label:'masculine', colour:'#60a5fa' },
feminine: { def:'die', indef:'eine', label:'feminine', colour:'#f472b6' },
neuter: { def:'das', indef:'ein', label:'neuter', colour:'#fbbf24' },
plural: { def:'die', indef:'\u2014', label:'plural', colour:'#a78bfa' }
};

const kindNotes = {
letter:'Letter of the alphabet', umlaut:'Umlaut sound', ligature:'Special letter',
phonics:'Pronunciation rule', number:'Number', day:'Day of the week', month:'Month',
season:'Season', daypart:'Part of the day', colour:'Colour (adjective)',
hobby:'Activity', greeting:'Greeting phrase', departure:'Farewell phrase',
query:'Question word', 'informal time':'Time phrase', dialogue:'Useful sentence',
routine:'Everyday sentence', split:'Has a male and a female form',
expression:'Expression'
};

function bareNoun(item) {
return String(item.german).replace(/^(der|die|das)\s+/i, '').trim();
}

function wordGrammar(item) {
const gi = genderInfo[item.gender];
if (gi) {
const noun = bareNoun(item);
return {
isNoun: true, colour: gi.colour, label: gi.label,
definite: gi.def + ' ' + noun,
indefinite: gi.indef === '\u2014' ? '\u2014' : gi.indef + ' ' + noun,
note: item.gender === 'plural'
? 'Plural nouns take die and have no indefinite article.'
: 'Nouns are always capitalised in German.'
};
}
return { isNoun:false, colour:'#94a3b8', label:item.gender,
note: kindNotes[item.gender] || 'Not a noun \u2014 no article needed.' };
}

// Compact card used by both the flashcard and the postcard
// every German form inside the chips is marked so Chrome leaves it alone
function grammarChips(item) {
const g = wordGrammar(item);
if (!g.isNoun) {
return `<div class="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left" style="background:rgba(148,163,184,.12)">
<p class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider" style="color:${g.colour}">${g.label}</p>
<p class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 mt-0.5">${g.note}</p>
</div>`;
}
return `<div class="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left space-y-1" style="background:rgba(148,163,184,.12)">
<p class="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider" style="color:${g.colour}">${g.label}</p>
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
<div>
<p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Definite</p>
<p class="text-xs font-black text-slate-100" translate="no" lang="de">${g.definite}</p>
</div>
<div>
<p class="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Indefinite</p>
<p class="text-xs font-black text-slate-100" translate="no" lang="de">${g.indefinite}</p>
</div>
</div>
<p class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">${g.note}</p>
</div>`;
}

function wordOfTheDay() {
const all = [];
Object.keys(allVocabularyDatabase).forEach(c => allVocabularyDatabase[c].forEach(i => all.push(i)));
const day = Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000);
return all[day % all.length];
}

function toggleRoomObject(id) {
if (showCoachmark) clearCoachmark();
openRoomObject = (openRoomObject === id) ? null : id;
renderActiveTabModule();
}

function objOpacity(obj) {
const f = objProgress(obj).frac;
return f === 0 ? 0.32 : (f < 1 ? 0.74 : 1);
}

function renderBearRoom(conf) {
const SCENE = sceneObjects();
const O = {}; SCENE.forEach(o => O[o.id] = o);
const pal = roomPalettes[timeOfDay()];
const wotd = wordOfTheDay();
const season = seasonNow();
const sp = seasonProfiles[season];
const moment = momentOfTheDay();
const showMoment = !momentSeenToday();
const totalDone = SCENE.filter(o => objProgress(o).frac === 1).length;
const suggest = suggestedObjectId();

// Outlines first: an unlearned object is a clear line drawing, not a ghost.
// Learning fills it with colour and finally writes its German name on it.
// Outline colour must contrast with the wall, which changes with the hour.
// A dark brown line vanishes on the night-time wall, so it lightens.
const dark = timeOfDay() === 'night';
const INK = dark ? '#d9c5aa' : '#7c5a3f';
const ZONE = dark ? '#8b83a6' : '#bda583';
const st = (id) => {
const f = objProgress(O[id]).frac;
return { f, stroke: f === 1 ? 'none' : INK, sw: f === 1 ? 0 : 2.4 };
};
const fill = (id, colour) => {
const f = objProgress(O[id]).frac;
if (f === 1) return colour;
if (f > 0) return colour;
return 'none';
};
// A small tap button sits on every item so nothing has to be hunted for.
// Amber = not started, half-ring = in progress, green tick = finished.
const PIN_TOWN = {
newsstand:[122,282], tower:[300,110], bank:[452,168],
townhall:[622,130], square:[452,392], theatre:[806,192]
};
const PIN_STREET = {
station:[112,150], shop:[268,196], cafe:[404,196], office:[540,150],
flat:[676,132], clinic:[806,196], work:[196,300], school:[458,300],
bench:[628,404], park:[812,330]
};
const PIN_DISTRICT = {
uni:[140,180], newsroom:[336,236], court:[540,168],
hq:[736,132], clinicb2:[250,384], congress:[640,392]
};
const PIN = activeLevel === 'B2' ? PIN_DISTRICT : activeLevel === 'B1' ? PIN_TOWN : activeLevel === 'A2' ? PIN_STREET : {
fridge:[104,188], cupboard:[252,180], stove:[254,262], ktable:[200,382],
door:[646,134], calendar:[750,88], mirror:[842,96], coatrack:[302,132],
shelf:[430,198], desk:[500,278], window:[500,72], rug:[592,424],
bed:[866,266], clock:[664,312]
};
// After the welcome, a single arrow points at the first thing to tap.
// It disappears the moment any corner is opened.
const coachmark = () => {
if (!hasBeenWelcomed() || !showCoachmark || !suggest) return '';
const c = PIN[suggest]; if (!c) return '';
return `<g pointer-events="none">
<path d="M${c[0]} ${c[1]-30} l-9 -16 h18 z" fill="#4f46e5">
<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,0; 0,-8; 0,0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
</path>
<rect x="${c[0]-46}" y="${c[1]-76}" width="92" height="24" rx="12" fill="#4f46e5"/>
<text x="${c[0]}" y="${c[1]-59}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif"
font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff">Hier tippen</text>
</g>`;
};

const pins = () => SCENE.map(o => {
const c = PIN[o.id]; if (!c) return '';
const p = objProgress(o);
const done = p.frac === 1;
const bg = done ? '#22c55e' : (p.frac > 0 ? '#f59e0b' : '#4f46e5');
const glow = suggest === o.id ? `<circle cx="${c[0]}" cy="${c[1]}" r="20" fill="${bg}" opacity=".28">
<animate attributeName="r" values="15;23;15" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
<animate attributeName="opacity" values=".35;0;.35" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>` : '';
return `<g class="room-pin" onclick="toggleRoomObject('${o.id}')" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Open ${o.en}">
${glow}
<circle cx="${c[0]}" cy="${c[1]}" r="15" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".92"/>
<circle cx="${c[0]}" cy="${c[1]}" r="13" fill="${bg}"/>
<text x="${c[0]}" y="${c[1]+5}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif"
font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff">${done ? '\u2713' : '+'}</text>
</g>`;
}).join('');

const grp = (id, inner, lx, ly) => {
const o = O[id];
const p = objProgress(o);
const op = p.frac === 1 ? 1 : (p.frac > 0 ? 0.62 : 1);
const label = p.frac === 1 && lx !== undefined ? `
<g pointer-events="none">
<rect x="${lx-56}" y="${ly-13}" width="112" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1e293b" opacity=".9"/>
<text x="${lx}" y="${ly+3}" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif"
font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#fde68a">${o.de}</text>
</g>` : '';
return `<g class="room-obj ${suggest === id ? 'room-suggest' : ''}" opacity="${op}"
onclick="toggleRoomObject('${id}')" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="${o.en}">${inner}${label}</g>`;
};

// ============ A2: Bruno's street ============
const streetSvg = () => {
const b = brunoInRoom();
const building = (id, x, w, h, colour, roof) => {
const y = 340 - h;
const f = objProgress(O[id]).frac;
const body = f === 1 ? colour : 'none';
const line = f === 1 ? 'none' : INK;
const lw = f === 1 ? 0 : 2.4;
let win = '';
for (let r = 0; r < Math.floor(h / 60); r++) {
for (let c = 0; c < Math.floor(w / 46); c++) {
win += `<rect x="${x + 14 + c * 46}" y="${y + 20 + r * 60}" width="26" height="30" rx="4"
fill="${f === 1 ? (pal.lampOn ? '#fde68a' : '#cfe3ee') : 'none'}"
stroke="${f === 1 ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.15)' : INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
}
}
return `<g>
<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="6" fill="${body}" stroke="${line}" stroke-width="${lw}"/>
<path d="M${x - 8} ${y} L${x + w / 2} ${y - 26} L${x + w + 8} ${y} Z" fill="${f === 1 ? roof : 'none'}" stroke="${line || INK}" stroke-width="2.4"/>
${win}
<rect x="${x + w / 2 - 16}" y="${340 - 44}" width="32" height="44" rx="4"
fill="${f === 1 ? roof : 'none'}" stroke="${line || INK}" stroke-width="2.2"/>
</g>`;
};
const treeAt = (x) => `<g><rect x="${x - 4}" y="352" width="9" height="26" fill="${sp.tree}" opacity=".8"/>
<circle cx="${x}" cy="344" r="20" fill="${sp.tree}"/></g>`;
return `
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 480" width="100%" style="display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

// built lazily so the inactive scene never looks up objects it does not have
// ============ B1: the town ============
const townSvg = () => {
const b = brunoInRoom();
const blk = (id, x, y, w, h, colour, roof) => {
const f = objProgress(O[id]).frac;
const line = f === 1 ? 'none' : INK;
let win = '';
for (let r = 0; r < Math.floor(h / 54); r++)
for (let c = 0; c < Math.floor(w / 44); c++)
win += `<rect x="${x + 12 + c * 44}" y="${y + 18 + r * 54}" width="24" height="28" rx="4"
fill="${f === 1 ? (pal.lampOn ? '#fde68a' : '#cfe3ee') : 'none'}"
stroke="${f === 1 ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.14)' : INK}" stroke-width="2"/>`;
return `<g>
<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" rx="6" fill="${f === 1 ? colour : 'none'}" stroke="${line}" stroke-width="2.4"/>
<rect x="${x - 6}" y="${y - 14}" width="${w + 12}" height="14" rx="4" fill="${f === 1 ? roof : 'none'}" stroke="${line || INK}" stroke-width="2.2"/>
${win}
</g>`;
};
return `
